mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_pet WHERE player_id = #{playerId}

SELECT pp.*, pt.id as t_id, pt.name as t_name, pt.type as t_type, pt.rarity as t_rarity, pt.base_hp as t_base_hp, pt.base_attack as t_base_attack, pt.base_defense as t_base_defense, pt.base_magic_attack as t_base_magic_attack, pt.base_magic_defense as t_base_magic_defense, pt.base_speed as t_base_speed, pt.hp_growth as t_hp_growth, pt.attack_growth as t_attack_growth, pt.defense_growth as t_defense_growth, pt.magic_attack_growth as t_magic_attack_growth, pt.magic_defense_growth as t_magic_defense_growth, pt.speed_growth as t_speed_growth, pt.description as t_description, pt.image_url as t_image_url, pt.is_starter as t_is_starter FROM player_pet pp LEFT JOIN pet_template pt ON pp.pet_template_id = pt.id WHERE pp.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO player_pet ( player_id, pet_template_id, nickname, level, exp, next_level_exp, iv_hp, iv_attack, iv_defense, iv_magic_attack, iv_magic_defense, iv_speed, current_hp, max_hp, attack, defense, magic_attack, magic_defense, speed, status, friendship, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{playerId}, #{petTemplateId}, #{nickname}, #{level}, #{exp}, #{nextLevelExp}, #{ivHp}, #{ivAttack}, #{ivDefense}, #{ivMagicAttack}, #{ivMagicDefense}, #{ivSpeed}, #{currentHp}, #{maxHp}, #{attack}, #{defense}, #{magicAttack}, #{magicDefense}, #{speed}, #{statusCondition}, #{friendship}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE player_pet SET player_id = #{playerId}, pet_template_id = #{petTemplateId}, nickname = #{nickname}, level = #{level}, exp = #{exp}, next_level_exp = #{nextLevelExp}, iv_hp = #{ivHp}, iv_attack = #{ivAttack}, iv_defense = #{ivDefense}, iv_magic_attack = #{ivMagicAttack}, iv_magic_defense = #{ivMagicDefense}, iv_speed = #{ivSpeed}, current_hp = #{currentHp}, max_hp = #{maxHp}, attack = #{attack}, defense = #{defense}, magic_attack = #{magicAttack}, magic_defense = #{magicDefense}, speed = #{speed}, status = #{statusCondition}, friendship = #{friendship}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
